_note: Controlled vocabulary for judged per-video tags (pipeline/features.py). Pick by the definitions, not by taste: Phase 3 correlates these with performance, so consistency beats richness. Each field: one definition, and the allowed values with one-line definitions.

hook_type.definition: What the first ~2 seconds of audio/text does to grab attention.

values.question: Opens by asking the viewer a question (spoken or on-screen).
values.bold_claim: Opens with a surprising or provocative statement of fact or opinion, no question mark.
values.number_fact: Opens on a specific number, date or measure as the hook (60,000 years, 17 places, 1.8 crore years).
values.mystery: Opens with an unexplained puzzle or teaser that withholds the answer, without a literal question.
values.action_cold_open: Opens mid-event: a battle, a strike, a chase, with no setup.
values.dialogue: Opens on a character speaking in quotes.
values.emotional_appeal: Opens with a feeling-led address to the viewer (love, loyalty, sorrow, pride), not a fact or question.

story_type.definition: The narrative shape of the video as a whole.

values.battle: A fight or war is the main event.
values.sacrifice: A character gives up life, throne or comfort for someone or something.
values.mystery_evidence: Investigates whether/where something real exists: places, texts, archaeology.
values.festival: Explains the origin or meaning of a festival.
values.devotion: Loyalty, love or worship between a devotee and a deity or elder.
values.origin: How a god, rite, name or practice came to be.
values.moral_dilemma: A character is tested or must choose between two right/wrong paths.
values.sacred_geography: Tells the story through real places and routes.

emotion.definition: The single dominant emotion the video aims to leave in the viewer.

values.awe: Wonder at scale, power or the sacred.
values.grief: Sorrow, loss, tenderness at death or separation.
values.curiosity: A wish to find out more; puzzle-solving.
values.pride: Pride in heritage, courage or fidelity.
values.devotion: Reverence, love and surrender toward the divine or a dharmic ideal.

epic.definition: The textual tradition the story comes from.

values.ramayana: Valmiki Ramayana and its direct episodes.
values.purana: A Purana-sourced story (Devi Mahatmya, Vishnu Purana, etc.).
values.folk: Regional or oral tradition not anchored in one text.
values.festival_lore: Stories assembled across several texts around a festival.

protagonist.definition: The main character the story follows, one lowercase single name (rama, jatayu, kali, hanuman, krishna, ...). For place-led or ensemble videos use the character who carries the story, else the narrator-led subject.

audio_type.definition: How the audio track carries the video.

values.narration: Voiceover is the main audio, with only incidental sound effects.
values.song: A commercial/licensed song carries the video, no voiceover.
values.dialogue_plus_song: Characters' speech or quoted lines over a song.
values.narration_plus_music: Voiceover with a prominent score or music bed.

song_genre.definition: Genre of the song if the video uses one.

opening_visual.definition: What the first frame / the YouTube thumbnail shows.

values.face_closeup: A character's face fills the frame.
values.wide_epic: A wide landscape or scene with figures small in it.
values.text_card: Title text or typography is the main element.
values.action: A visible physical action, clash or motion moment.
values.map_or_diagram: A map, route, diagram or archaeological photo.

thumbnail_text.definition: Text burned into the thumbnail / first frame.

values.short_text: Up to about 4 words or a single line.
values.long_text: More than about 4 words or several lines.

cta.definition: Explicit call to action in the video's audio or on-screen text.

values.comment_prompt: Asks a question or invites viewers to comment.
values.part_next: Points to the next part or episode.
